case.summary: Transaction 3441648 ($49.91) on card C09530-K1 was flagged by monitoring due to a high second-generation model score of 0.992 despite a low legacy risk score. The transaction was an online purchase for product category H, which departs sharply from the cardholder's established history of 149 in-person purchases in product category W and occurred just 1.5 hours after an in-person charge in region 272. Knowledge graph analysis linked the operating device D003615 to three other cards experiencing identical ~$50 online charges within a 7-day window, as well as twelve confirmed fraud closed cases. The activity was confirmed as card-not-present fraud with 0.97 probability. Card C09530-K1 was blocked, connected cards were placed under monitoring, and a SAR filing was initiated.

sar.narrative: This Suspicious Activity Report details unauthorized card-not-present transactions and multi-card compromise associated with customer account C09530 and card C09530-K1. On November 8, 2016, at 18:56:15 UTC, an unauthorized transaction (3441648) in the amount of $49.91 was conducted online in billing region 264 for product category H. The transaction was processed via device D003615, characterized by an iOS mobile safari profile (iOS Device, iOS 11.2.5, 2436x1125). Historical baseline analysis of card C09530-K1 shows that 149 of 155 past transactions were conducted in person for product category W, making this online purchase an abrupt departure from normal account usage. Furthermore, this unauthorized online transaction took place merely 1.5 hours after an in-person purchase (transaction 3441356) was executed on the same card in region 272. Graph analytics revealed that device D003615 was actively shared across three other cards (C04661-K1, C06147-K2, and C06374-K1) within a 7-day window, exhibiting a cross-card lift of 48.43 over baseline. On November 6, 2016, connected cards C06147-K2 and C04661-K1 were subjected to near-identical ~$50 online charges for product category H executed just seven seconds apart using the same device. Historical case records also establish that device D003615 is linked to twelve confirmed fraud closed cases, including CC-5231, CC-3893, and CC-3696. Direct fraudulent exposure identified for card C09530-K1 totals $49.91. The institution has blocked card C09530-K1, placed all connected card accounts under active surveillance, and submitted this filing in accordance with reporting guidelines.

stop_reason: The investigation concluded under policy section 6 because the fraud probability reached 0.97, well exceeding the decisive threshold of 0.85. The determination is supported by multiple independent incriminating bases, including cross-card device sharing, prior confirmed fraud cases, and behavioral anomalies, meaning further investigative steps would not alter the decision.
